entities.summary: Julien Gauthier is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Springfield Thunderbirds of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the St. Louis Blues of the National Hockey League (NHL). Gauthier was drafted 21st overall by the Carolina Hurricanes in the 2016 NHL entry draft. He has previously played for the Hurricanes, New York Rangers, Ottawa Senators, and New York Islanders.
